# DB Desk

> A native, keyboard-first database browser for macOS, Windows and Linux. Read-only until you say otherwise, credentials encrypted on your machine, one window for every engine you touch.

Engines: PostgreSQL, Amazon Redshift, CockroachDB, Greenplum, MySQL, MariaDB, SingleStore, Microsoft SQL Server, ClickHouse, SQLite, DuckDB, Elasticsearch, InfluxDB 3, libSQL, Cloudflare D1, MongoDB, Redis / Valkey, MCP servers, HTTP SQL gateways.

Read-only by default; writes need an explicit toggle, and production connections need a single-use approval bound to a hash of the exact statement. Credentials are encrypted at rest on the user's machine, and the AI features send schema and SQL, never rows, values or keys.

## Docs
- [Getting started](https://dbdesk.app/docs/getting-started.html): Install DB Desk and connect a database.
- [Features](https://dbdesk.app/docs/features.html): Everything in the app, screen by screen.
- [MCP server](https://dbdesk.app/docs/mcp.html): Expose your databases to local agents over MCP.
- [Security](https://dbdesk.app/docs/security.html): What DB Desk reaches, what leaves your machine, threat model.
- [Development](https://dbdesk.app/docs/development.html): Build from source, run the suite, package.
- [Signing](https://dbdesk.app/docs/signing.html): Sign and notarize a release.
- [Troubleshooting](https://dbdesk.app/docs/troubleshooting.html): Symptom, cause, fix.
- [Security model](https://dbdesk.app/security/): what leaves the machine, measured, with the script that reproduces the numbers.
